editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: allenai/olmocr
items.summary: Developed by AllenAI, olmocr is a toolkit that converts PDF documents into text formats suitable for large language models. This software facilitates data set preparation processes by providing linear processing of complex document structures.

items.title: togatoga/karukan
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, Karukan is a Japanese input method system (Japanese Input Method System) that uses a neural kana-kanji conversion engine for Linux and macOS operating systems. The software goes beyond traditional methods and offers an artificial intelligence-based approach to text conversion processes.

items.title: TencentCloud/CubeSandbox
items.summary: Developed by TencentCloud in Rust, CubeSandbox offers an instant, simultaneous and secure working environment (sandbox) for artificial intelligence agents. This tool, which stands out with its lightweight structure, enables agent-based systems to operate in an isolated area.

items.title: For first time, a cell built from scratch grows and divides
items.summary: Synthetic cells designed from scratch successfully completed the growth and division processes in a laboratory environment for the first time. This development represents a critical stage in the effort to reconstruct the basic functioning of biological systems and understand the origins of life.

items.title: ZCode – Harness for GLM-5.2
items.summary: ZCode provides an improved testing and evaluation framework for GLM-5.2 language models. This tool is used to measure the performance of large language models and standardize development processes.

items.title: FFmpeg 9.1's new AAC encoder
items.summary: FFmpeg version 9.1 includes a new advanced audio encoder (AAC encoder) that improves audio encoding quality. This update provides higher audio fidelity and efficient compression performance, especially at low bit rates.

items.title: Show HN: Searchable directory of 22k+ products from worker-owned co-ops
items.summary: Listing more than 22 thousand products produced by worker-owned co-ops, the directory allows users to reach these businesses directly. The platform offers an alternative marketplace experience by increasing the discoverability of cooperative-focused products.

items.title: What to learn to be a graphics programmer
items.summary: For those who want to become a graphics programmer, core competencies such as mathematical foundations, hardware architecture and graphics application interfaces (graphics APIs) stand out. This roadmap offers a comprehensive learning curve for those who want to learn low-level systems programming and visualization techniques.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF, developed by DeepReinforce-AI, is a language model focused on text generation. The model is presented in compressed GGUF format in order to use hardware resources efficiently.

glossary.explanation: Artificial intelligence models trained with huge data that can understand human language and produce text.
